Sharpen every image with an unsharp mask.

Adds back the detail a Gaussian blur of the given radius removes: image + amount x (image - blur). With a threshold, only pixels whose detail is above it change. Done once when the images are prepared: OpenCV on the CPU workers, in canvas order with the other steps done once; every epoch reads the result. Same result in training, validation and test.

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amount | `amount` | Number | `1.0` | `>=0` | The run | How much detail is added back. |
| Radius | `radius` | Number | `1.0` | `>0` | The run | Sigma of the blur, in pixels. |
| Threshold | `threshold` | Number | `0` | `0-1` | The run | Detail below this (0 to 1) is left alone. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Image Sharpen is a training image step done once when the images are prepared: OpenCV on the CPU workers; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Image Sharpen -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Done once when the images are prepared (OpenCV, CPU), in canvas order before the first random step. Runs in training, validation and test.
```

## Tips

- Soft or slightly blurred images.
